action_items: Documentation nitpick (NOT a bug): the review request mentions URL '/emergency-contacts' but the actual route is '/safety' (see /app/frontend/src/routes/clientRoutes.jsx line 29). The route mapping is consistent with the SideMenuDrawer link and the ProfilePage 'menu.emergency_contacts' entry — keep '/safety' or add an additional alias if marketing wants the literal slug.
critical_code_review_comments: trip_share.create_trip_share idempotency keys on (ride_id, created_by) — so a rider and the assigned driver each get their own token for the same ride. That's fine semantically but you may want to surface the rider's own token to the driver too so SOS contacts shared by either party are unified; currently they create two parallel public links.

trip_share.get_trip_share returns the cleartext rider phone always, including for ENDED rides (active=False). Confirm with product that rider PII should remain visible after the ride ends — if not, blank out client.phone when active is False.

phase1.add_favorite_driver: count is computed AFTER the 'already exists' short-circuit, which is correct (re-adding the same favorite doesn't bump the count). Good. But the response message is hard-coded English ('Added') — minor i18n inconsistency given the 400 detail is French.
phase1.list_emergency_contacts uses .to_list(10) but the cap is 5 — the limit hint should match the business rule (use .to_list(5)).

trip_share.ride_auto_share returns 404 for both 'ride not found' and 'not owner' — that's good privacy hygiene (no information leak), but tests against an authenticated non-owner should still verify the same 404 (not done end-to-end here because we'd need a second logged-in user provisioned).
